dishes.name: Zwolse balletjes
dishes.desc: Small pillow-shaped sweet candies sold in Zwolle since 1845. In flavours like mandarin and mocha.

dishes.name: Zwollenaartjes
dishes.desc: Hazelnut meringue pastries with mocha cream. A Zwolle patisserie speciality.

dishes.name: Deventer koek
dishes.desc: Dense spiced cake from nearby Deventer, sliced and buttered. A classic from Overijssel.

dishes.name: Boerenkool stamppot
dishes.desc: Mashed potato with kale and smoked sausage. Served in winter in Zwolle restaurants.
